<title
    level="1"

>
[Awakened Magic](/Feats.aspx?ID=5298) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Awakened Animal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=787" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 25

</column>

---

When you awakened, primal magic was released within you. Choose one [cantrip](/Traits.aspx?ID=550) from the [primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4) spell list. You can cast this spell as an primal innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

<title level="2">Awakened Magic leads to...</title>
[Animal Summoner](/Feats.aspx?ID=5314)
